---
#title: "Digital Media and Methods Lab"
css: 
  - custom.css

page-layout: custom
#navbar: false

listing:
- id: research
  contents: 
    - research/digital-news
    - research/methods
    - research/digital-technology
    - research/crisis
  
  sort: false
  type: grid
  grid-columns: 4
  max-items: 4
  image-height: 150px
  fields: [image, title]
  page-size: 4
  categories: false
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  feed: false

- id: news
  sort: "date desc"
  type: grid
  fields: [image, title, subtitle, date]
  grid-item-align: left
  grid-columns: 3
  image-height: 200px
#  categories: true
  max-items: 3
  page-size: 3
  contents: 
    - news

- id: publications
  sort: "date desc"
  type: grid
  fields: [image, title, subtitle, date]
  grid-item-align: left
  grid-columns: 3
  image-height: 200px
#  categories: true
  max-items: 3
  page-size: 3
  contents: publications.yml 
include-in-header: 
  - file: files/includes/_mswebmaster.js
---
